verdict.rationale: Isaac ROS lists teleoperation among the production-ready ROS packages it deploys, and Isaac Sim mentions Isaac TeleOp, though only as a source of real-world captures to convert into USD. That is a first-party teleoperation capability, but there is no evidence of an ops-facing remote-control experience. Missing for 10: live video streaming to the operator, latency/responsiveness guarantees over real-world (WAN/cellular) networks, documented remote-operator UI or workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
